what: Send the 7, 3 and 1-day plan-end and trial-end reminders as a free staff browser alert and an admin-app bell line, instead of waiting for a paid WhatsApp message
why: The nightly job already works out who is due, then throws the list away because the WhatsApp step is a stub that sends nothing; the free browser-alert channel already reaches the owner with the admin app closed
impact_why: Every gym that renews late or lets its trial end without paying is lost MettleUp money; this reaches them for free
my_view: My view: do it before the online plan purchase goes live. Use the alert path that exists now and keep WhatsApp for later, when it is worth its per-message cost. The trial gyms belong in the same list.

what: Ping the owner's own phone (the installed HQ app) the moment a new lead or a help question arrives, instead of only counting it on Needs you when HQ is open
why: Needs you only counts things while the HQ page is open. A lead that comes in at 11 am waits until he next opens HQ. Sales research (Harvard Business Review, 'The Short Life of Online Sales Leads', 2011, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) found that answering within the hour makes a lead far more likely to become a sale
impact_why: Each website lead is a gym that might pay; calling it while it is still warm is the cheapest way to win more of them
my_view: My view: worth doing. HQ can already be installed and the browser-alert sender is already built for gyms; point it at his account too. One alert per lead, no daily summary.

what: Move a lead to Won by itself when the gym made from it pays for its first plan (confirmed UPI or online), and write the move in the HQ log
why: Making a gym from a lead already moves it to Demo, but Won is only ever set by hand, so the lead list and any won-rate number lag behind the money
impact_why: Gives a true count of leads that became paying gyms without extra taps
my_view: My view: do it; the gym already carries the lead it came from, so this is a few lines on the payment path. Never move a lead to Lost by itself.

what: Pay the reward for gym-to-gym referrals automatically: a lead that came through another gym's link carries that gym, and when it becomes a paying gym the referring gym gets one free month on its paid-until date, written in the HQ log
why: The owner-to-owner share link is already proposed for the admin app, but nothing on the server rewards the gym that sent a paying gym, so the loop has no pull
impact_why: Gym owners in a city know each other; a free month for each paying gym they send is cheaper than any ad
my_view: My view: build it together with the admin app's 'Recommend MettleUp to another gym' idea (IM-L18-panel-ui-shell-05), not alone. The reward lands only after the first payment, so a fake lead earns nothing.

what: Let an HQ message go to a group of gyms (trial gyms, one plan, one city) instead of always every gym, and show how many gyms opened it
why: An HQ message has a title, body, link and label but no audience and no seen count, so a 'your trial ends soon' note would reach paying gyms too, and he cannot tell if anyone read a notice
impact_why: Lets him use the bell for trial nudges and Pro offers without bothering every gym
my_view: My view: do the groups first, the seen count second. Three fixed groups are enough; no free-form filter.

what: Flag paying gyms that are going quiet on Needs you: check-ins this week at less than half their 30-day pace, or no desk activity for 5 days, before their paid-until date
why: The gym list already holds last desk activity and 7 and 30-day check-ins for every gym, but Needs you only raises new gyms; a paying gym that stops using the desk is the one most likely not to renew. Customer-success tools such as Gainsight and ChurnZero sell exactly this 'health score' (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: One call to a quiet gym a month before renewal can save a whole year's plan
my_view: My view: do it as one Needs you line that opens the list, next to the trial-gym line already proposed for HQ (IM-L18-hq-app-05). Count only paying gyms here so the two lines do not repeat.

what: When a monthly gym's plan-end reminder goes out, offer the yearly plan with the saving in rupees, using the yearly plan the billing code already supports
why: Monthly, yearly and lifetime plans already exist, but the renewal moment only ever asks for the same plan again
impact_why: A yearly payment brings 12 months of cash at once and removes 11 chances to leave
my_view: My view: yes, but only after the plan-end reminder itself reaches gyms (IM-L18-server-hq-gate-workers-01). One line and one button, no pop-up.

what: When the door machine link goes live, send the gym an urgent staff alert when a machine stops calling in for 30 minutes during opening hours
why: The admin app can show a machine as online or offline, but only when someone looks; a machine that drops off Wi-Fi silently stops recording entries until a member complains
impact_why: Only matters once the door link is switched on, then it saves a day of lost entries
my_view: My view: build it with the door link's switch-on, not before; the link is not live yet.

what: Add a weekly automatic restore check: read last night's backup back, count its rows per table, compare with the live totals, and show 'last restore check passed' next to the backup's health answer
why: The nightly backup reports only that a copy was made and when; whether it can be restored rests on a hand-run drill written in a note
impact_why: A backup that cannot be restored is found out on the worst day; a weekly check finds it on a quiet one
my_view: My view: worth doing, as table counts only, never gym rows. Run it in the cloud on Sundays, not from the laptop.
